lead_independence.headline: Vero Beach woman arrested in $37,000 altered check scheme
lead_independence.lead: Chavi Rose-Marie Hammock, 23, of Vero Beach was arrested Aug. 28 on an active warrant charging her with grand theft and uttering a forged instrument. The Indian River County Sheriff's Office said the case originated after law enforcement in New York reported that two checks had allegedly been altered and deposited into a TD Bank account belonging to Hammock. One of the checks was changed from $800 to $17,658 before it was deposited.
